description: Are you a dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse looking for a consistent weekend schedule? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Gulfport, MS, is seeking a compassionate LPN to join their team for a specialized Baylor shift. This role offers the opportunity to provide essential patient care in a supportive environment.This unique position requires commitment to working 12-hour shifts every Saturday and Sunday. This is not a PRN role; we are looking for a reliable professional who is specifically seeking and comfortable with this weekend schedule. If you are ready to make a significant impact on patient well-being while enjoying a structured work-life balance, we encourage you to apply.Join a team dedicated to excellence in patient care and contribute to a positive healing environment. Your expertise will be vital in ensuring the highest standards of health and comfort for our residents.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in Mississippi.
Ability to commit to working 12-hour shifts every Saturday and Sunday.
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting preferred.
Strong clinical skills and a compassionate approach to patient care.

description:

Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations pertaining to special education and student services
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $60 per hour, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Rehabilitation to lead our therapy services at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Etowah, TN. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future of patient care and foster a collaborative environment for our therapy team.

As the Director of Rehabilitation, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of our physical, occupational, and speech therapy programs. You will ensure the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care, manage departmental operations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to achieve optimal outcomes for our residents.
requirements: Current and valid state licensure as a Physical Therapist (PT), Occupational Therapist (OT), or Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP)
Minimum of 3-5 years of clinical experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role
Proven experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation center setting
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing therapy services

requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum of 3-5 years of marketing experience, preferably in a healthcare or long-term care setting
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement successful marketing and public relations strategies

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Business Office Manager to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Etowah, TN. requirements: Certified Dietary Manager (CDM) certification required
